crossRefs.note: Most certainly I tell you, we speak that which we know, and testify of that which we have seen, and you don’t receive…
For the Father has affection for the Son, and shows him all things that he himself does. He will show him greater works…
I have many things to speak and to judge concerning you. However he who sent me is true; and the things which I heard…
No longer do I call you servants, for the servant doesn’t know what his lord does. But I have called you friends, for…
They came to John and said to him, “Rabbi, he who was with you beyond the Jordan, to whom you have testified, behold…
He who has received his witness has set his seal to this, that God is true.
He came to his own, and those who were his own didn’t receive him.
Why, when I came, was there no one? When I called, why was there no one to answer? Is my hand shortened at all, that it…
Who has believed our message? To whom has Yahweh’s arm been revealed?
But they didn’t all listen to the glad news. For Isaiah says, “Lord, who has believed our report?”
God didn’t reject his people, which he foreknew. Or don’t you know what the Scripture says about Elijah? How he pleads…

parallels.note: If we receive the witness of men, the witness of God is greater; for this is God’s testimony which he has testified…

translations.web: What he has seen and heard, of that he testifies; and no one receives his witness.
translations.bsb: He testifies to what He has seen and heard, yet no one accepts His testimony.
translations.kjv: And what he hath seen and heard, that he testifieth; and no man receiveth his testimony.
translations.asv: What he hath seen and heard, of that he beareth witness; and no man receiveth his witness.
